Sub HighlightCombinations()

    Dim picked As Collection
    Set picked = New Collection

    Call FindCombos(vals, addrs, n, 1, 0, picked, MIN_SUM, MAX_SUM)

                       ByVal minSum As Double, ByVal maxSum As Double)

    Dim i As Long, item As Variant

        picked.Add i
        FindCombos vals, addrs, n, i + 1, total + vals(i), picked, minSum, maxSum
        picked.Remove picked.Count
    Next i
End Sub

Private Sub SearchCombos(vals, cells, ByVal n As Long, ByVal idx As Long, _
